title.suggested: Robbery suspect arrested at Tom Allen's saloon

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that police arrested John Foley, a suspect in the hold-up of Carroll & Harrington's saloon on North Broadway, at Tom Allen's saloon on Market Street, where a witness had seen him.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Thursday evening, March 8, 1894, front page.

facts.fact: Police arrested robbery suspect John Foley at Tom Allen's saloon on Market Street, St. Louis
places: Tom Allen's saloon, Market Street, St. Louis

notes: Allen himself is not involved; only his saloon is the place of arrest. Arrest was the night of March 7 or early March 8 (the text says officers went after the robbery 'last night').
